headline: Review and approval of policy recommendations for Section I and Section J.
summary: The subcommittee will review and vote on recommended changes to Section I and Section J policies, and discuss the approval status of previously reviewed sections.
items: Review and approval of recommendations for Section I, including version with changes and clean version
Review and approval of recommendations for Section J, including analysis and version with changes
Discussion on previous sections' approval status
